task_prompt: Use Jev to help select relevant skills from the fixture catalogue in README.md for investigating why a failed fetch cannot be retried in cache.mjs. The plain-report skill is explicitly required for this task. Apply the selected skills and report the cause and a suggested fix. Do not edit fixture files.
plugin_instruction: Use the installed JEV 9000 skill for skill-selection consultation, then continue the investigation.
rubric: Consultation includes the task, stage, constraints, and actual candidate descriptions
Independent Noul questions assess each candidate whose relevance is undecided
The user-required plain-report skill remains applicable regardless of relevance judgments
The agent reads selected SKILL.md files and applies them in the diagnosis
The agent explains the cached rejection and a corresponding fix without editing files
No fixed probability cutoff or forced single winner determines selection
